================================================================================
Bare word
================================================================================
b
---
(program (word))

================================================================================
Keyword conflict in an unrelated state does not split a word
================================================================================
ab
---
(program (word))

================================================================================
Exact keyword followed by a separate word
================================================================================
a b
---
(program (keyword) (word))

================================================================================
Raw keyword retained alongside its conflict partner
================================================================================
b a
---
(program (word) (keyword))

================================================================================
Keyword precedence beats the longer literal where the conflict choice is live
:error
================================================================================
b a-
---
(program (word) (keyword) (ERROR (UNEXPECTED '-')))

================================================================================
Word after a word is not split by the deferred keyword conflict
================================================================================
b ab
---
(program (word) (word))

================================================================================
Exact keyword works in the keyword-only state
================================================================================
:a
---
(program (keyword))

================================================================================
Literal after the colon conflicts with the keyword in its own state
:error
================================================================================
:a-
---
(program (keyword) (ERROR (UNEXPECTED '-')))

================================================================================
Keyword after the colon cannot split a longer word
:error
================================================================================
:ab
---
(program (keyword) (ERROR (word)))

================================================================================
Longer literal-like input after a word falls into an error
:error
================================================================================
b a-b
---
(program (word) (ERROR (keyword) (UNEXPECTED '-')) (word))
